verdict.rationale: Activepieces' Mintlify API reference renders a per-endpoint "Try it" playground, backed by a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document with per-operation specs, so its own reference is interactive and runnable. Running requests is limited: it targets the production cloud server and needs a Platform/Enterprise-only API key, with no documented sandbox. The playground's presence is also inferred from config (the disabled-playground setting is absent) rather than shown hands-on. Missing for 10: request execution without a paid-edition key, a sandbox or test environment for running examples, and hands-on or independent confirmation that the playground works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The API reference renders the Mintlify "Try it" playground per endpoint
executing requests needs a Platform/Enterprise API key
Activepieces publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (84 paths, server https://cloud.activepieces.com/api) backing its Mintlify API reference
